usageNotes: Use this to bind a subscription pool key to a specific node on a managed remote. The caller must hold `System.Modify` on the PDM system plus `PRIV_RESOURCE_MODIFY` on the target remote — you cannot assign a key to a remote you lack authority on. Returns null on success; check for a 4xx/5xx error response to detect conflicts.

examples.summary: Assign a PVE community key to node pve-prod-01 on remote datacenter-hetzner

tips: Supply the optional `digest` param (SHA256 of the current config) to prevent lost-update races when multiple operators manage subscription assignments concurrently.
Key format is strictly `pve<N><tier>-<10 hex chars>` for PVE keys or `pbs<tier>-<10 hex chars>` for PBS keys — validate client-side before calling to surface format errors early.
A node value of `localhost` is accepted and refers to the node local to the remote, useful when the remote has a single node.
This call is synchronous and returns null — no UPID is issued; completion is immediate or an error is returned.
